name: technonomicon
title: Technonomicon
description: Editorial plates, issue layouts, growth labels, data-backed collector cards, and the opt-in pencil sketch layer.

.caps-stage-plate-key > li.transition:
color var(--stipe-motion-slow) var(--stipe-motion-ease),
      border-color var(--stipe-motion-slow) var(--stipe-motion-ease)

.caps-cigarette-card-face.border:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 55%, var(--card-frame))

.caps-cigarette-card-window.border:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-frame-ink) 30%, var(--card-frame))
.caps-cigarette-card-window.boxShadow:
inset 0 0.6cqi 1.8cqi -0.4cqi var(--card-shadow),
      inset 0 0 0 0.6cqi color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-window) 70%, transparent)

.caps-cigarette-card-collector.borderTop:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 45%, transparent)

.caps-cigarette-card-ledger.border:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-frame-ink) 30%, var(--card-frame))

.caps-cigarette-card-stat.borderBottom:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-rule) 35%, transparent)

.caps-cigarette-card-leader.borderBottom:
var(--card-rule-width) dotted
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-rule) 60%, transparent)

.caps-cigarette-card-sources.borderTop:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-rule) 35%, transparent)

.caps-cigarette-card[data-finish=\"full-.border:
var(--card-rule-width) solid
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-rule) 40%, transparent)
